items.text: I just voted no. As a legislator for almost 30 years, this may be the worst piece of legislation I have ever voted on. This bill will steal health care from 17 million Americans. This bill will cause hospitals and nursing homes to close and make health care more expensive. This bill will lavish trillions on the wealthy and give painfully little to the middle class in what may be the biggest upward transfer of wealth in U.S. history. This bill will cost $4,000,000,000,000.00. This bill will add trillions of dollars to our national debt. This bill slaps New Jerseyans in the face by refusing to remove the state and local tax deduction cap, a cap which would have expired this year if no action was taken. This bill was produced in the dead of night with virtually no debate, no discussion, no analysis, and no regular order and then rammed through before anyone could actually read it. This is a shameful day for the U.S. Congress.

A new report finds the Republican budget law could kill 1,000 Americans every year from cruel Medicaid cuts. 

In our district over 195,000 people rely on Medicaid. The Republican budget is one of the most destructive bills ever passed by Congress. https://t.co/0P6D2gLLYN

Happy 60th birthday today to Medicare and Medicaid, signed into law in 1965 by Pres Johnson (with an assist from Pres Truman). These programs are foundational to American life and I will always use my office to protect them from threats. https://t.co/WFla3rvBcT

I was so happy to join #Edgewater seniors today to answer good questions about the Republican budget law and the current threats to Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security. Thank you Mayor McPartland for inviting me to a great discussion! https://t.co/k85fDJCamy

This weekend our office hosted a joint event with the Passaic County Clerk in #Clifton. During our mobile office hours we offered help with Social Security, Medicare, VA IDs, and other areas. If you ever need any constituent service help call our office any time 973-523-5152! https://t.co/i9gXTciBzB

Donald Trump and Republicans promised Americans a new “golden age.” Instead, they’ve delivered chaos, a healthcare crisis, and another Republican shutdown. 

I’m in Washington to help find an agreement that protects your health care and reopens the government. https://t.co/v0qg4RI9Dg

The Republican plan means higher costs and less coverage. It's time to return to Washington, protect your health care, and end this shutdown.

El plan republicano significa mayores gastos y menor cobertura. Es hora de regresar a Washington, proteger tu cuidado médico y terminar este cierre gubernamental.
Americans are rightly worried our troops will go unpaid and their health care premiums will soar from this Republican shutdown. Speaker Johnson: It’s time to call the House back and get to work.

Federal workers are working without pay. SNAP benefits are running out and Americans across the country are receiving notices of increases on their health care premiums. It’s time we start lifting working families up instead of tearing down the White House.

SNAP benefits are at risk and health care premiums are increasing. Working families need their representatives in Washington working for them. @HouseDemocrats are ready to work to reopen the government and lower costs for families.

Thousands of families in our district will see their health care premiums soar under the current Republican plan. It’s time to head back to Washington, reopen the government, and protect working families’ health care. Let’s get it done.

I joined my delegation colleagues calling on urgent action to protect SNAP benefits for New Jerseyans who depend on this program. Costs are going up and now working families are being squeezed by higher health care premiums. When will it be enough for this administration?
I will vote no to any so-called government funding deal that will not stop Republican price hikes on health care premiums. This is a bad deal. My full statement: https://t.co/WliWkGUrTt

I voted NO on the Republican proposed funding package because I will not support any proposal that does NOTHING about your rising health care costs. I came to Washington to fight for you and lower your costs.
Americans across the country are being forced to choose between health care and putting food on the table. Read the room.
It’s been about nine years since that ‘two weeks’ promise. I’m sure his health care proposal is just delayed… https://t.co/7ggB52pMCj
Can’t keep the government open or lower costs or present a health care plan but will have a “bridge package” ? https://t.co/S5rLpkwouc
Republicans promised Americans they’d lower costs. Now, they’re turning a blind eye as health care costs soar. Broken promises. Nothing new.
More than 30,000 of my constituents stand to lose their health insurance. House Republicans still have time to do the right thing and work with @HouseDemocrats to reduce the cost of health care.
No American should be forced to choose between paying for their health care or groceries. The economy isn’t working for working families and something must be done.

House Republicans were happy to shut down the government instead of extending ACA tax credits. Now we’re halfway through December with still no plan from them to lower health care costs. @HouseDemocrats are ready to work. Are they?
Trump says kids should “give up pencils” and have fewer toys. What’s next, less food? Less health care? We can’t let him get away with this.

Recently, over 80 women joined a lawsuit together alleging that Dr. McGraw made sexual advances and lewd comments towards them, as well as secretly recorded patients during exams. Enough is enough. My colleagues and I are demanding accountability and justice for the victims.

The affordability crisis isn’t a ‘hoax’ — in fact, it has worsened as a result of House Republicans’ failure to extend ACA tax credits. Working families are struggling and cannot afford higher health-care bills.

Families are hurting this holiday season as costs soar. By refusing to extend ACA tax credits, House Republicans are forcing impossible choices: groceries or health care. Enough is enough. It’s time Congress put families first.
